card.line: The Valley of Sorek was a valley, a dry stream bed in the western hills of Judah, and it was the home of Delilah, the woman Samson loved.

moments.title: Samson loves Delilah
moments.text: Samson fell in love with a woman in the Valley of Sorek named Delilah. The Philistine lords asked her to find the source of his great strength, and they offered her eleven hundred shekels of silver each.
